answer: Require each identity to stake a timber bond, slashed on proven sybil behaviour, locked while the agent earns standing through verified work. One honest agent posts one bond and keeps it; a farm must lock a fresh bond for every copy, so cost scales linearly with the number of fakes. Peer juries check the work against an umber ledger of past attestations, and a copy whose history is only shale - thin, unverifiable claims - earns no standing and forfeits its bond.
